title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.45: The Chaotic Book and Book of Order are replaced by a single relic, the Book of Endings. Study it at a Rest Site to reveal one alternative Boss on the current act's map, up to 2 per act - no transform to unlock first, and the allowance refreshes every act. The Study option greys out once the act's alternative Bosses are all revealed, and an act's Boss layout is now fixed before anything is revealed, so revealing the second alternative never re-arranges the first.
